item.title: Mötley Crüe bassist NIKKI SIXX Explains DOLLY PARTON Collab: 'She Was a Hard Yes'
item.description: Mötley Crüe and Dolly Parton have released a new version of Home Sweet Home to mark the song’s 40th anniversary. The track debuted at No. 1 on the Mediabase Classic Rock Songs chart in June.

item.title: MÖTLEY CRÜE's NIKKI SIXX Wants to Live to 100 and 'Outlive His Critics' Along the Way
item.description: Nikki Sixx isn’t just chasing the next riff anymore. NOPE! These days, he’s got his sights set on something a bit more ambitious than a chart position or a sold-out arena, he’s aiming for triple digits.

item.title: NIKKI SIXX Reveals Why MÖTLEY CRÜE Were Missing From OZZY OSBOURNE’s Farewell Show
item.description: Fans of Mötley Crüe noticed something missing during Ozzy Osbourne’s massive Back to the Beginning farewell concert in Birmingham: the Crüe themselves. The event, held on July 5, was billed as a once-in-a-lifetime celebration.

item.title: John Corabi on Mötley Crüe Exit: "Relieved and Bummed"
item.description: John Corabi (yes, the guy who briefly fronted Mötley Crüe) sat down for an interview and spilled—well, not tea exactly, but maybe lukewarm coffee. His time with the band?

item.title: Why Tommy Lee Showers Once a Week, According to His Wife
item.description: Tommy Lee, drummer for Mötley Crüe, bathes sparingly. His wife, Brittany Furlan, says he showers only once a week. The detail emerged on Kaitlyn Bristowe’s Off the Vine podcast, where Furlan spoke about her husband’s habits.

item.title: John 5 Breaks Silence on Relationship With Rob Zombie After Joining Mötley Crüe
item.description: John 5, the guy who’s jumped from Rob Zombie’s ship straight into the glam-coated arms of Mötley Crüe, apparently hasn’t had a real chat with Zombie since his departure.

item.title: Korn Showed Us the Ropes, Mötley Crüe Wanted Us Off the Stage, Says Jacoby Shaddix
item.description: Touring for over two decades brings a lot of memories—some good, some you’d rather forget. When Jacoby Shaddix and Jerry Horton of Papa Roach sat down with Q101, they didn’t hold back on sharing stories from the road.
